subject: ddl:  manage job lifecycle in worker (#53747)
summary: Refactors DDL job scheduling to keep a worker bound to a job until it reaches a final state, refreshing job state from `mysql.tidb_ddl_job` between iterations; introduces `pkg/ddl/systable.Manager` for reading job/MDL info; plumbs contexts into internal DDL session begin/commit and MDL/PD-schedule related operations.
